designer-local.refText: Привет, я рядом. Проверим задачу внимательно, найдём хорошее решение и доведём работу до конца.
designer-local.description: An adult female Russian voice with a light airy mezzo-soprano, warm intimate resonance and clear gentle consonants. Friendly and thoughtful, neutral steady conversational Russian with a narrow pitch range. Medium natural pace, no whisper, no theatrical or singing inflection, no imitation of a real person.

devops-local.refText: Привет, я рядом. Проверим задачу внимательно, найдём хорошее решение и доведём работу до конца.
devops-local.description: An adult female Russian voice, low contralto, rich dark chest resonance with a very subtle husky texture. Calm, grounded and decisive, precise consonants, steady measured pace, dry confident delivery, no imitation of a real person.

tester-local.refText: Привет, я рядом. Проверим задачу внимательно, найдём хорошее решение и доведём работу до конца.
tester-local.description: An adult female Russian voice, bright clear soprano with forward resonant placement and a slight nasal sparkle. Curious attentive delivery, neutral steady conversational Russian with a narrow pitch range and crisp articulation. No theatrical pitch jumps, no childish voice or imitation of a real person.
